input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there

doc_friction.issue: Says start multi-minute jobs with run_in_background, but that tool caps a job at 2 h; a pre-registered experiment documented as 'about two hours' needs setsid nohup (or a split) to survive. Worth one line on jobs over ~100 min.

Its draw pointed at two programmes both touched within the last hours (one with an open PR), and did not list stalled research draft PRs such as #15442, which prompt-0's 'Land before you build' asks to handle first; found it only by listing open PRs by hand.

deviations.why: Pushed to my own session branch instead of the stalled PR's branch (session rule: push only to the assigned branch); cherry-picked its one commit unchanged so the pre-registration timestamp survives in history.
deviations.did: New PR #15572 carrying #15442's commit; #15442 closed as superseded.

deviations.why: Its docstring says the predictions are also in LOG.md, but the original session never wrote that LOG entry; the run.py commit is the pre-registration record.
deviations.did: LOG entry written after the run, quoting the predictions and naming the commit and PR they came from.

goal: advance the hanger-codesign programme's critical path (milestone 3, top-tier cloth solver acceptance)
notes: Verification: hanger-codesign unittest discover 46 tests OK (5 new); research/_homepage/build.py ok; research_live_links --write and check_md_links ok. Experiment: 98/98 part-1 stages and 8/8 part-2 solves converged, 7742 s on 4 cores; B1, B4, B5 held; B2, B3 (by 0.0025), B6 (2 of 106) refuted. Post hoc (labelled, not registered): saddle check of the two negative-eigenvalue states (one genuine saddle, one flat direction) and the lowest-energy-seed DC change (0.001-0.009) vs seed mean (0.020-0.033).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: re-running a 2 h pre-registered FEM sweep, a saddle check, tests, figure and write-up: about a day and a half for a grad student

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
